operationalNotes.label: Sunday declaration
operationalNotes.value: Preferred quality path is 7B AWQ if registration can be updated; otherwise keep the current 3B declaration honest.

operationalNotes.label: Illegal Sunday bases
operationalNotes.value: Never use 7B bf16, 7B GPTQ-Int8 at 8.875 GB, or Bielik-11B as the Sunday base.

operationalNotes.label: Image ceiling
operationalNotes.value: Many history items require images, so text-only models still have a hard ceiling without tool or image support.

operationalNotes.label: Sunday size rule
operationalNotes.value: Base must stay <=8.0 GB on disk and <=8.8 GB after fine-tuning.

operationalNotes.label: Ops hygiene
operationalNotes.value: Refer only to the current Forgehand L40S host in shared notes and never commit IPs, SSH keys, TEAM_KEY values, tokens, or passwords.

refresh.title: Update only dashboard/status.json for normal status refreshes
refresh.summary: The page shell is static; the data file is the control plane. Other bots can add or edit cards without touching the HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
steps: Open dashboard/status.json and update the fields that changed: updatedAt, highlights, jobs, results, or operationalNotes.
Seed new values from committed notes like STATUS.md and notes/TRACK01_BEST_SCORE.md.
Commit and push to main, then redeploy the dashboard/ folder to your preferred public static host.
